links.comparator_used: Default prompt with no readability request (same chatbots, standard prompt)
links.outcome: Readability of AI chatbot output (FRE and FKGL)
links.effect: With a readability-improvement request, average output readability fell by nearly six grade levels (FRE 69.0; FKGL 6.8), versus default AI output (FRE 36.1; FKGL 12.3); only 2% of default AI responses met the eighth-grade standard.
links.quote: However, when the input prompt included a request to improve readability, AI models lowered average output readability by nearly six grade levels (FRE 69.0; FKGL 6.8).
